name: aglit-plugin
description: Connect devices through Aglit, set up private-network Agentic Dev Swarm development with visual dev PR proof, and author speech-reactive avatars.

interface.shortDescription: Devices, private dev swarms and avatars
interface.longDescription: Set up and connect to supported computers through Aglit. Enroll an Apple silicon Mac or Windows x64 PC, discover physical phones and simulators through compatible original-host adapters, configure simulator input, and register vendor-app or localhost device control interfaces. Device actions require an authenticated tool connection and an installed runtime exposing the documented schema. This instruction-only plugin does not install the CLI, drivers, or native runtime, create an MCP connection, or grant device trust. First-time sign-in and OS permissions retain their normal handoffs. Private SSH remains conditional on compatible macOS runtime support. Includes a storybook-avatar skill for transparent GIF authoring, mouth calibration, scoped GIF/image/VRM replacement, voice/background selection and actual-product verification. Avatar actions require the installed p1_avatar schema; this does not add Live2D support or grant microphone access. Agentic Dev Swarm Setup explains a one-device or private-network development topology, verifies actual hot reload, and publishes one dev branch with code-linked before/after images or video in a rolling PR. Rebase merges require user approval. No VPN, device trust or production deployment is installed or granted by this instruction-only skill.
capabilities: Private-network development and visual PR review
defaultPrompt: Help me connect to my Office Mac through Aglit.
Set up my Windows PC for remote access through Aglit.
Help me register a simulator or printer control interface through Aglit.
Set up an Agentic Dev Swarm with private hot reload and before/after proof in one dev PR.
